hypothesis: When nesting a horizontal segmented capsule inside a motion-drag bottom sheet, omitting touch-manipulation and pointer event stop-propagation allows the parent drag gesture to hijack button taps and induces a 300ms click delay on WebKit mobile browsers.

Removing visible text labels without equipping every button with an accurate, translated title and aria-label blinds screen readers and assistive tech, causing accessibility violations (WCAG 2.1 AA 4.1.2).

Reordering buttons to [navigate -> streetview -> flyover -> more_photos -> open_gmaps -> share] without updating TC-6 assertions will desynchronize the physics sentinel test suite and allow layout drift.
